d:
Purn sharabbandi vale bihar ke madhepura jile se khaki ko sharmasar karne vala mamla samne aaya hai. yahan pahle se nilanbit chal rahe ek pulis adhikari ko sharab ke nashe men dhut hokar bajar men girne ke bad pulis ne giraphtar kar jel bhej diya hai.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
